title: Tic-Tac-Toe Network Edition
tagline: Real-time multiplayer Tic-Tac-Toe over the network — from different web browsers or different computers entirely.

features.title: Play with anyone
features.desc: Two players connect from different browsers — no account needed

features.title: Timed turns
features.desc: You have 5 seconds to make your move or your turn is skipped

features.title: Pick your look
features.desc: Choose a nickname and color before each game

features.title: Instant rematch
features.desc: Jump straight into another round without refreshing

context: Built to explore real-time communication between users — the core challenge was keeping two separate browsers perfectly in sync without any delay.
